description: Selected combined-ticket >=2% conservative EV with 1% compounded gross-price stress per leg, no individual-leg EV veto, distinct parlay and total game exposure caps.
notes: Official default selection STANDARD, not an automated wagering deployment.
A historical positive ROI does not prove positive future EV; calibrator worse than no-vig market in 2016-2025 testing.
The $120 total-game cap is applied to combined existing straight + parlay exposure; $20 cap applies only to parlays. Straight exposures above $120 cannot receive additional parlays.
Never force additional bets or size stakes merely to match the 199 historical selection count.
Historic moneyline quotes are not executable simultaneous sportsbook parlay prices.
